helpers.lastSummary: 4 new network programs; best: HexClad on Awin, up to 20%, 30-day cookie.

findings.title: HexClad (US) on Awin
findings.detail: Up to 20% (10% assumed), 30-day cookie. Est. $0.30/click vs Amazon $0.27 ($0.60 at 20%).

findings.title: Made In Cookware on FlexOffers
findings.detail: 8% new / 6.4% returning, 30-day cookie. Est. $0.18/click vs Amazon $0.20.

findings.title: Sur La Table on Partnerize
findings.detail: 4-7% (unverified), 30-day cookie (15 on Impact). Est. $0.10/click vs Amazon $0.135.

findings.title: Etsy on Awin
findings.detail: ~4% (unverified), 30 days on web, 7 in the app. Est. $0.03/click vs Amazon $0.036, but covers unique gifts Amazon lacks.

findings.title: Pans-worth-the-splurge gift pins
findings.detail: 3-5 hero-pan vs budget pins before Black Friday (Nov 27). Use HexClad/Made In once approved.

findings.title: One Awin account, two programs
findings.detail: HexClad + Etsy share one Awin sign-up and one $20 payout threshold, so you get paid sooner.

findings.title: Sign up next: Rollo (FlexOffers/CJ)
findings.detail: 12%, 30-day cookie, about $0.51/click vs Amazon $0.235. Assign to Kaze (yosemite) after you sign up.
